title: Bug 620761: Move subconracting tests from base app to subcontracting app
summary: Subcontracting-specific SCM and manufacturing tests moved from the base app to the subcontracting app for better maintainability, and production-order requisition line descriptions are restored after vendor validation using routing line data or work center names.
key_points: Migrated subcontracting test codeunits from base app to dedicated subcontracting test app
Restored Description and Description 2 fields on production-order requisition lines after vendor validation
Descriptions populate from matching production routing line or fallback to work center name
Removed obsolete and app-local disabled-test files
No changes to quantities, amounts, or posting behavior
quote: Move subcontracting-specific SCM and manufacturing tests from BaseApp into the Subcontracting test app so the tests are owned and maintained with the feature.
